caption: The drawing features a single, rounded vessel positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be made of clay or ceramic material, colored in shades of light to medium brown with subtle gradients suggesting volume and smooth texture. The vessel has a distinct double-lobed form with a spherical lower section, a narrow neck, and a wide, bowl-like opening at the top; the rim of the opening shows signs of chipping or wear. The base is flat and slightly raised, rendered in similar earthy tones. Near the bottom right edge of the drawing, there are signatures and notations in pencil, including the names "Corrected by Carmel Wilson" and another signature above it.
title: Letter Sander
